name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A box with its own scrollbars: a named region that keyboard users can Tab to and scroll, a focus ring inside the box, and scrollbars that stay visible.
docs: Akso UI Scroll area. Always name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
